patterns.name: Progress Indicator
patterns.description: Shows user where they are in a multi-step flow. Reduces anxiety and sets expectations for how many steps remain.

patterns.name: Benefit-Oriented Headline
patterns.description: Headlines that focus on user benefits rather than features. Answers 'What's in it for me?' immediately.

patterns.name: Hero Illustration
patterns.description: Large, prominent illustration or image that conveys the app's purpose or current step visually.

patterns.name: Progressive Disclosure
patterns.description: Reveal complexity gradually, showing only what's needed at each step to avoid overwhelming users.

patterns.name: Social Proof
patterns.description: Testimonials, user counts, ratings, or logos showing others trust this product.

patterns.name: Single Primary CTA
patterns.description: One obvious next step with limited choices. Reduces decision paralysis and guides user forward.

patterns.name: Sticky CTA
patterns.description: Call-to-action that remains visible as user scrolls, ensuring it's always accessible.

patterns.name: Bottom Tab Bar
patterns.description: Mobile navigation pattern with 3-5 primary sections accessible from bottom of screen. Thumb-friendly and always visible.

patterns.name: Hamburger Menu
patterns.description: Three-line icon that opens a slide-out or dropdown menu. Common for secondary navigation.

patterns.name: Breadcrumbs
patterns.description: Secondary navigation showing the path to current location. Helps users understand hierarchy and navigate back.

patterns.name: Prominent Search
patterns.description: Search bar given high visual priority, often in header. Signals findability and quick access.

patterns.name: Back Button
patterns.description: Clear way to return to previous screen. Essential for deep navigation hierarchies.

patterns.name: Floating Action Button
patterns.description: Circular button that floats above content, representing primary action for current screen.

patterns.name: Inline Validation
patterns.description: Real-time feedback on form field validity as user types or on blur. Reduces errors and frustration.

patterns.name: Smart Defaults
patterns.description: Pre-fill form fields with intelligent defaults based on context or user data to reduce effort.

patterns.name: Input Masking
patterns.description: Format input automatically (phone numbers, credit cards, dates) to match expected pattern.

patterns.name: Multi-Step Form
patterns.description: Break long forms into smaller steps to reduce cognitive load and increase completion.

patterns.name: Optional Field Marking
patterns.description: Clearly mark which fields are optional to reduce user anxiety and perceived effort.

patterns.name: Error Summary
patterns.description: List of all form errors at top of form, with links to problematic fields. Aids accessibility and clarity.

patterns.name: Infinite Scroll
patterns.description: Load more content automatically as user scrolls. Reduces clicks but can be disorienting.

patterns.name: Card Layout
patterns.description: Content organized into discrete card components. Scannable, flexible, and mobile-friendly.

patterns.name: Empty State
patterns.description: Helpful screen shown when no content exists yet. Educates users and suggests first actions.

patterns.name: Skeleton Screen
patterns.description: Show content structure while loading to set expectations and reduce perceived wait time.

patterns.name: Lazy Loading
patterns.description: Load images and heavy content only when needed (e.g., when scrolled into view). Improves performance.

patterns.name: Pull to Refresh
patterns.description: Mobile gesture to refresh content by pulling down on screen. Intuitive and satisfying interaction.

patterns.name: Like/Favorite
patterns.description: Quick action to save or endorse content. Low-friction engagement mechanism.

patterns.name: Share Button
patterns.description: Easy sharing to social platforms or messaging apps. Drives viral growth and content distribution.

patterns.name: Comment Thread
patterns.description: Nested or linear conversation structure. Encourages engagement and community.

patterns.name: User Avatar
patterns.description: Profile picture or icon representing user. Adds personality and helps identify content sources.

patterns.name: Notification Badge
patterns.description: Numbered indicator showing unread items or pending actions. Drives re-engagement.

patterns.name: Paywall Modal
patterns.description: Full-screen or modal overlay blocking access until payment. Clear upgrade path.

patterns.name: Pricing Table
patterns.description: Comparison grid showing different plan tiers and features. Helps users choose appropriate option.

patterns.name: Shopping Cart Indicator
patterns.description: Persistent cart icon with item count. Always accessible for checkout.

patterns.name: One-Click Purchase
patterns.description: Skip cart and checkout steps by using saved payment info. Reduces friction dramatically.

patterns.name: Free Trial CTA
patterns.description: Prominent offer to try before buying. Reduces perceived risk and increases conversions.

patterns.name: Toast Notification
patterns.description: Brief, non-intrusive message that appears temporarily to confirm actions or provide updates.

patterns.name: Loading Spinner
patterns.description: Animated indicator showing system is working. Prevents user uncertainty during waits.

patterns.name: Success Confirmation
patterns.description: Clear visual and textual confirmation that action completed successfully.

patterns.name: Error Message
patterns.description: Clear explanation of what went wrong and how to fix it. Should be actionable, not just descriptive.

patterns.name: Contextual Help
patterns.description: Tooltips, info icons, or inline help text that explains features without leaving context.

patterns.name: Onboarding Checklist
patterns.description: List of setup tasks that guides new users to value and shows progress.

patterns.name: Search Autocomplete
patterns.description: Suggest completions as user types to speed up search and guide discovery.

patterns.name: Filter Facets
patterns.description: Multiple filtering options to refine search results. Common in e-commerce and content discovery.

patterns.name: Minimal Navigation
patterns.description: Reduce navigation options during critical flows to maintain focus and reduce abandonment.
